## Mediana de la Exponencial

<div class="block-example fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <div class="block-title">Cálculo de la Mediana de Exp(λ)</div>
  <div class="block-body">
La mediana $m$ de $X \sim \text{Exp}(\lambda)$:
$$F(m) = 1 - e^{-\lambda m} = 0.5 \implies e^{-\lambda m} = 0.5 \implies m = \frac{\ln 2}{\lambda}$$
Para $\lambda = 0.2$: $m = \ln(2)/0.2 \approx 3.47$ horas, mientras que $E(X) = 1/0.2 = 5$ horas.
  </div>
</div>
<div class="block-example fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="2">
  <div class="block-title">En R</div>
  <div class="block-body">

```{r}
lambda <- 0.2
c(mediana = qexp(0.5, lambda), media = 1/lambda)
```

</div>
</div>
